name: AWS Certificate Manager
label: AWS Certificate Manager JSON API
description: AWS Certificate Manager API 2015-12-08 via OfficialApiNode, signed with AWS SigV4 (service acm). Docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html. Operations: get-certificate, list-certificates, get-metadata (DescribeCertificate), renew-certificate, delete-certificate, listen. Auth secrets access_key_id, secret_access_key, optional session_token are instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). Retrieved certificate PEM must not be logged. listen is kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_key_id, secret_access_key, or session_token here. Path params match api_spec.json placeholders. Example: {"operation":"get-certificate"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: get-certificate | list-certificates | get-metadata | renew-certificate | delete-certificate | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen is ingress: no HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'get-certificate'.

schema.label: CertificateArn
schema.description: ACM certificate ARN. Required except list-certificates.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Secret bytes in data must not be logged; bind them into StudioQuack secrets. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON from the official API. May contain secret material — never log; bind into StudioQuack secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: get-certificate, list-certificates, get-metadata, renew-certificate, delete-certificate, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: AWS access key ID
configurationParameters.description: IAM access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: ACM Region for acm.{region}.amazonaws.com. Certificates are regional.

configurationParameters.label: AWS secret access key
configurationParameters.description: IAM secret access key used to sign SigV4. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS session token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token. When set, OfficialApiNode adds x-amz-security-token. Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget (~300s).
